description: Expected aggregates computed from tenants/<tenant>/ground_truth/canonical_records.jsonl with the default attendance formula. Synthetic data.

formula.attendance_pct: sum(weight) / count(records with non-null weight) x 100, pooled over all records in scope (not a mean of employee percentages)
formula.excluded: HOLIDAY and WEEKLY_OFF records (null weight) are excluded from numerator and denominator
formula.missing_records: an employee-date without a record is unknown; it is neither counted nor ABSENT
formula.avg_total_hours: mean of total_hours over records that have total_hours, ROUND_HALF_UP to 2 decimals

missing_records.treat_as: unknown - a missing record is not an absence
